verdict.rationale: A shared visual whiteboard is a fair capability to ask of a collaborative work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a whiteboard or freeform visual canvas. monday 'boards' are work-item boards, and the ability to build custom board views or add 850+ integrations is a developer building block or adjacent feature, not a documented whiteboard.

support.subject: As a designer, I can collaborate visually with my team on a shared whiteboard
